body.name: published feasible unrestricted \(p=2\) raw interval and this note's totalized \(K\) restriction
body.construction: Under Watson et al. (2024, Theorem 2's validity/feasibility hypotheses; Corollary 2.1 and Appendix A.7), when \(\delta(P)\geq0\) the sharp set over an unrestricted scalar effect domain is the raw interval \([\theta_-(P),\theta_+(P)]\). Watson et al. treat the below-minimum case \(\delta(P)<0\) as infeasible/undefined rather than publishing an empty raw sharp set. This note separately and globally defines \(\Theta_I(P)=\{\theta\in K:q_P(\theta)\leq0\}\): its empty extension when \(\delta(P)<0\), and its equality to \(K\cap[\theta_-(P),\theta_+(P)]\) when \(\delta(P)\geq0\), are this note's totalization and parameter-space conventions.
